ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (29) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The Gospel passages are translated from Tolstoy's Russian, keeping his lowercase «отец» (otets, 'father') and «всевышний» (vsevyshniy, 'the most high') and lowercase pronouns for God (D0002). «Божеская любовь» (bozheskaya lyubov') is 'divine love' and «пристрастие» (pristrastie) 'partiality'; the opening quotation mark of the Matthew passage, which the source never closes, is kept as printed.

Source observation: [13] The Matthew 5:43–45 passage opens with a quotation mark («Вы слышали…) that is never closed in the source; the English reproduces the unclosed opening mark. Possibly a lost closing » after «неправедных».
